scope_limits: The documentary novelty claim is tentative and revisable under new prior-art evidence; this is the operational form allowed by Section6.3, not a mathematical proof of absence.

No historical-inspiration chronology is invented when an antecedent was discovered after implementation.
The ambiguity of one Faithful sketch remains documented; it neither adds a design nor refutes V3 novelty.
No novelty or results of V3 are transferred to the additive service or its796 jobs.
No claim of additional future information, new CRPS, increased universal point expressivity, optimization convergence or empirical calibration is made.
